results.title: Quito - Wikipedia, la enciclopedia libre
results.snippet: Quito, oficialmente San Francisco de Quito, es la capital de la República del Ecuador . Asimismo, es la capital de la provincia de Pichincha y cabecera cantonal del Distrito Metropolitano de Quito. results.title: Quito - Wikipedia
results.snippet: Quito (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈkito] ⓘ; Quechua: Kitu), officially San Francisco de Quito, is the capital of Ecuador , and the province of Pichincha. It is the largest city in Pichincha and the second-largest city in Ecuador , with an estimated population of 1.7 million in the city and 2.8 million in its metropolitan area.

results.title: Conoce las 24 provincias y capitales del Ecuador (Mapa)
results.snippet: Encuentra las 24 provincias y capitales del Ecuador , repartidas en cuatro regiones geográficas. La capital del Ecuador es Quito, que también es la segunda capital más alta del mundo.

results.snippet: Ecuador , [b] officially the Republic of Ecuador , [c] is a country in northwestern South America, bordered by Colombia on the north, Peru on the east and south, and the Pacific Ocean on the west. It also includes the Galápagos Province which contains the Galápagos Islands in the Pacific, about 1,000 kilometers (540 nmi; 620 mi) west of the mainland.
